Instrument / authority: United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (1992)
Legal role: Framework climate treaty establishing objectives, principles, reporting, cooperation, and common but differentiated responsibility logic.
Protocol establishing quantified emissions limitation and reduction commitments for developed-country parties and market mechanisms.
Current global climate treaty architecture based on nationally determined contributions, progression, transparency, global stocktake, finance, adaptation, and loss and damage.

Instrument / authority: Decision 1/CMA.5, Outcome of the first global stocktake (2023)
Legal role: COP28/CMA decision calling for transition away from fossil fuels in energy systems and tripling renewable energy capacity globally.

Instrument / authority: Fund for responding to Loss and Damage
Legal role: Institutional arrangement for loss-and-damage finance responding to climate impacts in vulnerable developing states.

Instrument / authority: ITLOS Advisory Opinion on Climate Change and International Law (2024)
Legal role: Advisory opinion connecting greenhouse-gas emissions to UNCLOS marine-environment obligations.

Instrument / authority: ICJ Advisory Opinion on Obligations of States in Respect of Climate Change (2025)
Legal role: General international-law advisory opinion on state climate obligations and legal consequences.
